goal: Add dark/light mode toggle, bilingual (Vietnamese/English) i18n support, and migrate the accent palette from lavender to pte-web blue brand colors

global_context.framework: Next.js 16.4 with Tailwind CSS v4 (used only for turbopack loader — all styling is vanilla CSS custom properties)
global_context.architecture: Feature-sliced: app/ routes, features/ modules, common/ shared utilities
constraints: No external i18n or theming library — lightweight custom React context implementations
All styling via CSS custom properties in globals.css — no Tailwind utility classes in components
Must not break existing API contracts, session storage, or test suite
Blue brand palette sourced from pte-web packages/ui/src/styles/design-tokens.css

phases.name: design-tokens
phases.description: Refactor globals.css into dual-theme CSS custom properties (dark + light) and migrate lavender accent to pte-web blue palette

phases.name: theme-provider
phases.description: Create ThemeProvider React context, blocking init script, update root layout, and add theme toggle to shell

phases.name: i18n-infrastructure
phases.description: Create bilingual i18n system with locale types, en/vi dictionaries, LocaleProvider, and integrate into root layout

phases.name: migrate-components
phases.description: Replace all hardcoded English strings in view components with t() translation calls and add locale toggle to shell

phases.name: polish-verify
phases.description: Final polish — smooth theme transitions, metadata, NAV_ITEMS i18n, build and test verification
